recent_posts.title: Live Streaming with Amazon Interactive Video Service
recent_posts.summary: Amazon Interactive Video Service (Amazon IVS) is a managed solution for low-latency or real-time live streaming. It also covers playback of live streams in a browser and setting up timed metadata.

top_posts.title: Microservices Patterns: Event Sourcing
top_posts.summary: Event Sourcing is a different way of structuring the business logic and persisting aggregates. It persists an aggregate as a sequence of events and each event represents a state change of the aggregate. It helps to preserve the history of aggregates, which is valuable for auditing and regulatory purposes.

top_posts.title: Swagger vs. OpenAPI: Understanding the Difference
top_posts.summary: Swagger was developed by Tony Tam in 2011 as an open-source framework for designing, building, and documenting RESTful APIs. Swagger focused primarily on API documentation, offering a user-friendly interface for developers to explore and interact with APIs. OpenAPI is the current version and the successor to Swagger.
